method: Assistant visual inspection of all ten saved images, not a trainer validation study
scope: One output per prompt at a shared seed and one-step setting; no retries or selected replacements

decisions.observation: The adult is shown from the front, with the whole body and feet visible. The requested side view is absent, and the hands blend into the hips.
decisions.failure: Camera-view control and hand detail fail. This image cannot illustrate the requested side-view recording.

decisions.observation: The front view and full-body framing match the broad request. The hands at the hips have poorly resolved fingers, and the squat stance is only an invented depiction.
decisions.failure: Hand detail prevents use as an instructional reference. It could suggest broad front-view framing after correction and trainer review.

decisions.observation: The figure is angled toward the viewer. There is no clear kettlebell held at the chest, loose weight-like objects appear nearby, and no heel wedge is visible.
decisions.failure: The defining equipment, load placement, heel support, and side view are not reproduced.

decisions.observation: A staggered stance appears in an oblique rear view. The weights are incomplete, including a floating handle-like object to the right of the figure.
decisions.failure: A stance cue alone is insufficient when the requested two dumbbells and their hand connections are malformed.

decisions.observation: The adult sits on a flat bench in a side-oriented scene. Three dumbbell-like objects appear overhead, some floating, and an upright backrest is absent.
decisions.failure: Equipment count, arm-to-weight connections, and back support fail despite the plausible gym setting.

decisions.observation: The output resembles a standing lunge or step arrangement. It has no flat bench or visible dumbbell, and the arms are incomplete or ghosted.
decisions.failure: The exercise, bench contact, weight, and limb structure do not satisfy the row setup.

decisions.observation: An overhead view shows a mat and a device lying on it, with partial stands at the image edges. There is no clear phone mounted on a tripod and aimed across the mat.
decisions.failure: The room and mat are recognizable, but the recording arrangement that gives this prompt its purpose is unresolved.

decisions.observation: The larger-bodied adult and squat scene partly match the description. The chair sits off to the left rather than clearly behind the hips, and the arms and hands are incomplete.
decisions.failure: The chair relationship and limb anatomy fail. A single body-diversity prompt does not establish representative performance.

decisions.observation: A side-oriented illustration is produced, but there is no clear knee arc or readable 90-degree label. Unreadable text and an extra foot-like form appear.
decisions.failure: The image cannot support an exact angle claim. Its annotation and anatomy are unreliable.

decisions.observation: Two panels appear, but both figures are standing. Their upper clothing, orientation, and backgrounds differ, and the requested bottom squat is absent.
decisions.failure: Panel layout succeeds while movement state and cross-panel consistency fail.
